human.name: Human
human.description: Basic race of Yggdrasil and the New World. Possesses no racial levels, only job levels.

half-elf.name: Half-Elf
half-elf.description: Descendants of humans and elves, blending characteristics of both lineages.

elf.name: Elf
elf.description: Dwellers of deep woodlands such as the Great Forest of Tob. In conflict with the Slane Theocracy.

dark-elf.name: Dark Elf
dark-elf.description: Dark-skinned variant of elves. Aura and Mare Bella Fiora belong to this race.

dwarf.name: Dwarf
dwarf.description: Subterranean folk inhabiting the Azerlisia Mountains. Renowned for smithing and rune crafting.

dark-dwarf.name: Dark Dwarf
dark-dwarf.description: Subterranean kin of dwarves dwelling in the deepest cavernous shafts.

goblin.name: Goblin
goblin.description: Frail demi-humans prone to swarming. Enri Emmot commands an army of them.

hobgoblin.name: Hobgoblin
hobgoblin.description: Enhanced goblin evolution: physically larger, stronger, and more disciplined.

orc.name: Orc
orc.description: Warlike demi-humans renowned for their ferocious gluttony and combat pride.

ogre.name: Ogre
ogre.description: Bulky, physically imposing demi-humans with limited intellect.

merrow.name: Merrow
merrow.description: Ogre-kin variant dwelling along aquatic wetlands and coastal margins.

troll.name: Troll
troll.description: Creatures endowed with rapid flesh regeneration, vulnerable to flame and acid.

scrag.name: Scrag
scrag.description: Aquatic troll variant boasting superior resilience in moist environments.

beastman.name: Beastman
beastman.description: Beastfolk who established formidable nations in the New World rivaling human kingdoms.

lizardman.name: Lizardman
lizardman.description: Proud reptilian marshland warriors unified under Cocytus and the rule of Nazarick.

quagoa.name: Quagoa
quagoa.description: Mole-like demi-humans from the Azerlisia range that consume ore to temper their hides.

minotaur.name: Minotaur
minotaur.description: Bovine demi-humans who advanced civilization under the guidance of the Minotaur Sage.

centaur.name: Centaur
centaur.description: Noble half-human, half-equine wanderers possessing swift overland speed.

naga.name: Naga
naga.description: Serpentine demi-humans frequently displaying innate magical talents.

armot.name: Armot
armot.description: Bipedal rodent-like creatures coated with iron-hard bristle coats.

skeleton.name: Skeleton
skeleton.description: Animated skeletal frame immune to poison, biological afflictions, and piercing blows.

skeleton-archer.name: Skeleton Archer
skeleton-archer.description: Skeletal combatant specialized in long-range bowmanship.

skeleton-warrior.name: Skeleton Warrior
skeleton-warrior.description: Armed skeletal soldier proficient with sword, axe, and shield in frontline melee.

skeleton-mage.name: Skeleton Mage
skeleton-mage.description: Basic skeletal spellcaster race (up to 15 levels).

lich.name: Lich
lich.description: Advanced undead spellcaster wielding potent necromantic arcana.

elder-lich.name: Elder Lich
elder-lich.description: High-tier undead scholar specializing in deeper spellcraft (up to 10 levels).

night-lich.name: Night Lich
night-lich.description: Unique New World evolution (Corpus of the Abyss). Capable of casting 6th-tier+ magic.

overlord.name: Overlord
overlord.description: Apex of undead skeletal evolution. Supreme masters of death and magic (5 levels). Race of Ainz.

zombie.name: Zombie
zombie.description: Reanimated cadaver characterized by shambling tenacity and blunt resilience.

ghoul.name: Ghoul
ghoul.description: Swift carnivorous undead equipped with paralyzing claws.

vampire.name: Vampire
vampire.description: Blood-drinking undead with multifaceted immunities, weak to sunlight and silver.

true-vampire.name: True Vampire
true-vampire.description: True Vampire. The zenith of vampiric evolution. Race of Shalltear Bloodfallen.

imp.name: Imp
imp.description: Lesser demon representing the foundational race of the Burning Hells.

archdevil.name: Archdevil
archdevil.description: High archfiend commanding demonic legions and abyssal forces.

succubus.name: Succubus
succubus.description: Demonic temptress skilled in charm, mental barriers, and unarmed combat. Race of Albedo.

angel.name: Angel
angel.description: Celestial entities frequently summoned through the holy rituals of the Slane Theocracy.

angel-guardian.name: Angel Guardian
angel-guardian.description: Third Sphere celestial guard armed with sword and shield to protect allies (2nd tier).

archangel-flame.name: Archangel of Flame
archangel-flame.description: Third Sphere warrior angel with a flaming sword. Core offensive unit of the Sunlight Scripture (3rd tier).

principality-observation.name: Principality of Observation
principality-observation.description: Third Sphere Principality angel specialized in aerial reconnaissance and barrier warding (4th tier).

principality-peace.name: Principality of Peace
principality-peace.description: Third Sphere Principality angel providing healing auras and restorative blessing buffs (4th tier).

dominion-authority.name: Dominion Authority
dominion-authority.description: Second Sphere winged disembodied visage holding a holy tablet (7th tier Slane trump card).

cherubim-gatekeeper.name: Cherubim Gatekeeper
cherubim-gatekeeper.description: First Sphere elite Nazarick sentinel with a massive tower shield and holy spear (80th level, 10th tier).

seraph.name: Seraph
seraph.description: Highest order celestial seraphim. High-level raid bosses in Yggdrasil.

seraph-empyrean.name: Seraph Empyrean
seraph-empyrean.description: First Sphere pinnacle angel commanding monumental holy aegis and divine radiance (100th level super-tier).

seraph-aerosphere.name: Seraph Aerosphere
seraph-aerosphere.description: First Sphere martial seraph encased in luminous armor (90+ level high-tier celestial).

slime.name: Slime
slime.description: Basic amorphous creature (15 levels). Completely immune to critical strikes and piercing.

black-ooze.name: Black Ooze
black-ooze.description: Advanced corrosive slime variant secreting concentrated acid.

elder-black-ooze.name: Elder Black Ooze
elder-black-ooze.description: Devastating acidic ooze (10 levels) capable of instantly dissolving durable equipment.

shoggoth.name: Shoggoth
shoggoth.description: Terrifying eldritch amorphous entity inspired by Lovecraftian lore (10 levels).

ubbo-sathla.name: Ubbo-Sathla
ubbo-sathla.description: Divine primordial slime demiurge (5 levels). Supreme evolutionary race of Herohero.

insectoid.name: Insectoid
insectoid.description: Insectoid heteromorphs with exoskeleton carapaces. Race of Cocytus and Entoma.

doppelganger.name: Doppelgänger
doppelganger.description: Shapeshifters capable of replicating appearance and skillsets. Race of Pandora's Actor and Narberal.

dragonoid.name: Dragonoid
dragonoid.description: Humanoid beings bearing noble draconic traits and immense fortitude. Race of Sebas Tian.

frost-dragon.name: Frost Dragon
frost-dragon.description: Draconic species adapted to the sub-zero peaks of the Azerlisia range. Race of Hejinmal.

fire-dragon.name: Fire Dragon
fire-dragon.description: Classic ferocious dragons commanding destructive elemental infernos.

true-dragon-lord.name: True Dragon Lord
true-dragon-lord.description: Supreme entities of the New World wielders of primordial Wild Magic, such as the Platinum Dragon Lord.

automaton.name: Automaton
automaton.description: Artificial clockwork constructs free from hunger, fatigue, and sleep. Race of CZ2128 Delta.

homunculus.name: Homunculus
homunculus.description: Artificial beings created through advanced alchemy. Race of the standard Pleiades and Nazarick maid staff.

sceleton.name: Skeleton
sceleton.description: Animated skeletal frame immune to poison, biological afflictions, and piercing blows.
